title: ononis pusilla subsp. saxicola
intro: Ononis pusilla subsp. saxicola, commonly known as rock candyroot or rock sweet, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the legume family (Fabaceae). This plant is valued for its traditional uses in medicine, particularly for its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Ononis pusilla subsp. saxicola include its ability to soothe digestive issues and alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections, attributed to its therapeutic actions such as expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
